question: Hootie & the Blowfish's 1994 debut sold over 20 million copies in the US. How many did its 1996 follow-up sell there?
answer: About 3 million, certified triple platinum by 1998. Cracked Rear View had needed everything to go right: the radio format of the moment, four hit singles, years of touring. Fairweather Johnson entered the chart at No. 1 and still sold about a seventh as much. A freak success is a poor forecast.
move: After an outlier, expect the next result to be closer to ordinary.
trap: Expecting a sequel to keep half a record-breaking debut's sales.
reference: Recording Industry Association of America, Gold & Platinum certifications for Cracked Rear View and Fairweather Johnson, 1998
